# COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_PROMPT

## Summary

The system prompt for the completeness-critic pass: the model receives a comparison sheet (reference photo leftmost, then front/side/three-quarter renders) plus the current spec JSON, and must find every part the reference clearly shows that the render is missing — with an explicit reminder that glazing and openings are the most-missed parts. Unlike the conservative refine pass, this pass is allowed to ADD parts (and nudge grossly misplaced ones), returning `critique`, `score`, `changed`, `added` and `materialsChanged`; it may not change primitives or dimensions, and may not remove parts.

## Import

```ts
import { COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_PROMPT } from '../prompts/completeness';
```

## Usage

Sent by `StudioIsolated` (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) as an extra vision round during generation; the pass is skipped when the build already realized every planned part, unless the user sets the `forceCompleteness` toggle.
